title: I've had multiple dream spaces for as long as I can remember.
content: I'm sure more will come to mind, just seeing this topic brought these to my waking consciousness immediately. One is a 5 way intersection with a line of small shops on one street, right on the sidewalk, not a strip mall, which is generally the focus point. It is a very mid-century design - sometimes more (tan) brick than storefronts but it's the same place. I don't remember much of consequence ever happening there, but I always at least pass it by. My innate fear is that it is the place where I will die, but nothing specific in my dreams points to it. In waking life, I am terrified of ever seeing this place, and places reminiscent of it elicit a fear response that eats at my gut. The other is a mall/shopping center. Very dingy, yellow space, very much like "liminal spaces." Usually a food court, smells like popcorn reminiscent of stores from my childhood (anybody remember that smell?). There is an escalator that goes nowhere and as a child I would sometimes be put on it and there was something very creepy waiting at the top, but definitely nowhere to go once you got there. Don't ever remember getting there, thank god. Sometimes, there is an entrance that is a roller coaster. The colors are wild and vivid. Often I am seated with a large, bigfoot-like creature with white hair that is very human and non-threatening. SOMETIMES that roller coaster goes into some sort of museum, and I'm no longer on the coaster. Sometimes the museum is frightening. Sometimes it is more of an aquarium-like exhibit. Either way something is always "off" about it, like I'm avoiding something or someone but not necessarily afraid. Regardless of any specifics, the places are the same, and familiar. I love being in them.
